steps.name: docker-runtime-image-contract
steps.summary: Added root Dockerfile and .dockerignore plus static Docker runtime image contract tests covering Python 3.12 base image, /workspace/app PYTHONPATH, bounded health CMD, and excluded env/data/git/cache/phase artifacts without requiring Docker daemon execution.

steps.name: compose-runtime-service-contract
steps.summary: Added Docker Compose one-shot runtime service contracts for token_payments_health, token_payments_worker, and token_payments_smoke sharing the root Dockerfile image, .env, /workspace/app PYTHONPATH, bounded commands, no restart policy, and explicit postgres/kafka/test_network dependencies.

steps.name: docker-runtime-smoke-scenario
steps.summary: Added docker-runtime-readiness smoke scenario and tests that statically validate Dockerfile, .dockerignore, .env.example, compose one-shot runtime services, ordered manual run commands, and bounded JSON CLI output without starting Docker or opening network clients.

steps.name: docker-compose-config-validation
steps.summary: Added daemon-less Docker Compose config validation tests for .env.example service resolution, documented config commands, and extended docker-runtime-readiness smoke details with the compose config validation command without using up/run/build or Docker socket access.

steps.name: docker-phase-public-verification
steps.summary: Added Docker phase public contract tests and README documentation tying Docker runtime image, compose runtime service, docker-runtime-readiness smoke scenario, and compose config validation contracts to daemon-less verification and manual live Docker order.
